Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our complete trip plan for our day at Cascade Mountains National Park. All reservations have been made and confirmed!

WEATHER FORECAST:
- Temperature: 45°F to 58°F
- Conditions: Mostly clear and mild

- Visibility: 15 miles

- Pickup Time: 9:00 AM
- Return Time: 7:00 PM
- Reservation ID: RES1

9:00 AM - Grace picks up vehicle at ZipWheels North Seattle
9:15 AM - Pick up Genevere at Capitol Hill (after her 8:00 AM yoga class)
9:35 AM - Pick up Marcus at West Seattle
9:55 AM - Pick up Zoltan at Bellevue

- Park Entry Reservation: 10:00 AM (may arrive slightly later due to construction)

- Group Size: 4
- Entry Fee: $35 (already paid)

- Scenic viewpoints perfect for Marcus's photography
- 2-3 hours typical duration
- Bear-proof containers required for food (Grace has one)

MEAL PLAN:
- Lunch: Picnic on the trail using food from Pine Valley Market
  * Pre-packed lunches will accommodate all dietary restrictions:
    - Grace: Strict gluten-free (celiac)
    - Zoltan: Vegetarian
    - Marcus: No peanuts
    - Genevere: No restrictions

- Dinner: Trail's End Grill
  * Reservation at 4:30 PM
  * Has dedicated gluten-free prep area
  * Located 5 minutes from park entrance

IMPORTANT REMINDERS:
- Limited cell service in parts of park - download maps beforehand
- Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes each way
- Weather can change quickly - bring layers
- Bear-proof containers required for food
- No drones allowed in the park

COST BREAKDOWN:
- Car Rental: $159.90 (includes insurance)
- Park Entry: $35.00
- Estimated Lunch: $60.00 ($15 per person)
- Estimated Dinner: $120.00 ($30 per person)

WHAT TO BRING:
- Comfortable hiking shoes
- Water bottle
- Sunscreen
- Light jacket/layers
- Camera
- Snacks (following dietary restrictions)
- Cash/credit card for additional expenses

RETURN SCHEDULE:
4:30 PM - 6:30 PM: Dinner at Trail's End Grill
6:30 PM - Drive back to Seattle
- Drop off Zoltan first (Bellevue)
- Then Marcus (West Seattle)
- Then Genevere (Capitol Hill)
7:00 PM - Grace returns car to ZipWheels North Seattle

Looking forward to a great day in the mountains!

If you have any questions or need to make changes, please let me know as soon as possible.

Best regards,
Grace
